name: @laot/bridge
description: LTBridge CLI for fetching and bundling FiveM modules.
author: laot

scripts.build: esbuild scripts/compile.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/compiler.cjs && node dist/compiler.cjs && esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/ltbridge.js
scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild tests/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --packages=external --out-extension:.js=.cjs --outdir=dist/tests && node --test "dist/tests/*.test.cjs"
